findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Bring your ideas to life with premium 3D prints" → 3 lines (9 words, 64px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 10 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Crafted on demand · Made in India" (pill) above "Bring your ideas to life with premium 3D"; "Editor's pick" above "Featured products"; "Just landed" above "New arrivals"; "Shop by category" above "Browse what fits your vibe"; "Going viral" above "Trending right now"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono — e.g. "100%", "1–3 days", "Premium", "₹539"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "04"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 16 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Crafted on demand · Made in India", "Customizable", "Dispatch time", "Print quality").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: 🕉 ✨ 🔔 📅 🌙 🏺 💝 🔱 🎙 ✍
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 6 gradient fill(s): div.bg-build-grid-light.pointer-events-none → radial-gradient(rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06) 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 1px) | div.bg-orb.pointer-events-none → radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 60%), radial-gradient(circle at  | div.absolute.-inset-8 → linear-gradient(to right bottom, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2), rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15), rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 1 gradient-filled text element(s).
findings.fix: Solid colour text.

findings.message: 55 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.hidden.items-center → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(16, 185 | span.inline-flex.items-center → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | a.group.inline-flex → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(16, 185
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 13 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.mt-5.flex 312px | div 702px | div 702px | div 702px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 39 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 6 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Spiritual & Artistic" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "₹599" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "Functional Products" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "₹799" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 12px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.8:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: 50 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 64px (4.4vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 687px of the width empty: "What our community is saying".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (112px, 368px, 137px, 125px, 613px, 857px, 1101px); the three most used hold only 42% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Made in our studio, printed for you" (screen 6, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 497px of nothing between: "Browse what fits your vibe"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: 3 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "₹499" (11px from the right); "₹499" (11px from the right); "₹499" (11px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Bring your ideas to life with premium 3D prints" → 3 lines (9 words, 36px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: 8 text block(s) sit 12–15px from the phone's edge: "Spiritual & Artistic" (13px); "Smart NFC Lord Hanuman Idol" (13px); "🕉️ Smart NFC Lord Hanuman Ido" (13px)
findings.fix: The page margin is 16–20px on a phone; the header and the corner labels sit on it too.
